# Transform

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/components/transform.h`](../../../src/logic/components/transform.h) · Scene / prefab name: `Transform` · Described in `data/core.json`

Position, rotation and scale of an entity in the world

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | world position, metres (0) |
| `rotation` | `glm::quat` | orientation (identity) |
| `scale` | `glm::vec3` | scale (1); a kinematic body with scale.x <= 0 is hidden and not moved by Physics |

## Notes

matrix() = translate x rotate x scale. Dynamic bodies' Transforms are written by Physics (interpolated) or PhysicsStep; kinematic bodies follow theirs.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md)**
  - Creates one proxy entity per world with a built animal, destroys them in finish.
  - Writes into other registries: the AnimalBot command of each world, read at the next world step.
- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md)**
  - Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
  - Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.
- **[AnimalLineup](../systems/AnimalLineup.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species, the origin, and each animal's place, height and clip count.
- **[AnimalSync](../systems/AnimalSync.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[AnimalWalkers](../systems/AnimalWalkers.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species or walks and each animal's clip, speed, radius and place.
  - Queries the ground field per animal per tick.
- **[BodySync](../systems/BodySync.md)**
  - Adds PhysicsPose to the drawn shape entities.
- **[BoxDrop](../systems/BoxDrop.md)**
  - Creates count entities in init.
- **[BoxRing](../systems/BoxRing.md)**
  - 12 dynamic boxes with Jolt bodies (made by RigidBodySys) 4 m + size above the ground, rotated about (1, 1, 0).
- **[BoxThrower](../systems/BoxThrower.md)**
  - A new entity with a dynamic Jolt body per click, never destroyed; colours cycle from a function-static counter.
- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Forest](../systems/Forest.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkForest> in preinit (onChunkForestDestroyed), disconnects in finish.
  - Reads ./resources/forest/tautavel.forest.json (or `definition`) in init, and resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates the plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs info (stands, layers, species, patch size), a warning per species the library lacks, an error without a terrain generator or with a bad definition (the system then does nothing).
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
- **[HerdWatch](../systems/HerdWatch.md)**
  - Moves the desktop camera every tick once it has a herd.
  - Logs the herd it chose.
  - Queries the ground field up to ten times a tick.
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md)**
  - Writes the mapped lights uniform buffer of the frame and sets Context::lights_buffers.
- **[ModelLineup](../systems/ModelLineup.md)**
  - Lists ./resources/models with std::filesystem (errors ignored) and loads each .gltf / .glb: files read, GPU buffers uploaded by the model loader.
  - One dynamic Jolt body per model (RigidBodySys).
- **[MountSpawn](../systems/MountSpawn.md)**
  - Creates `count` animal entities in init.
  - Logs a warning `MountSpawn : no animal <species> in the library` and makes nothing when the species is missing.
  - Without a GroundField but with a terrain, builds a TerrainField (with its own MarchingCubes) for the ground heights.
- **[MountSteering](../systems/MountSteering.md)**
  - None.
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[Physics](../systems/Physics.md)**
  - Steps the host's Jolt PhysicsSystem on its job system threads.
  - Destroys entities whose interpolated position is under -1000 m.
  - Runs the FixedSteps functions of other systems inside its tick.
  - Profiler zones Physics step, Fixed steps before, Jolt update, Fixed steps after; plots Physics steps, Active bodies.
- **[PhysicsStep](../systems/PhysicsStep.md)**
  - Steps the world's Jolt PhysicsSystem (single threaded with threads 1).
- **[PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md)**
  - At each 60 Hz physics step (FixedSteps.before): a narrow phase ray cast per player, `AddForce` of the stand, walk and jump forces, `ActivateBody`.
  - Sets the collision group of the player's body once (`SetCollisionGroup`).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md)**
  - None beyond the context variables.
- **[Probe](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Writes the probe CSV file, flushed after every sample.
- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md)**
  - At each physics step: `AddForce` on the rider's body ((pull - gravity) x mass) and `ActivateBody`.
- **[RigidBody](../systems/RigidBody.md)**
  - Creates, adds, removes and destroys Jolt bodies; OptimizeBroadPhase after static geometry is added.
  - Connects on_destroy<RigidBody>, on_destroy<Ground>, on_destroy<HeightField> (disconnected in finish and the destructor).
  - Log warnings on invalid shapes, invalid height fields and when Jolt is out of bodies.
- **[Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md)**
  - Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.
  - Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
  - Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
  - Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
  - Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).
- **[SandboxLife](../systems/SandboxLife.md)**
  - Drains the contact listener's recorded events (the listener is SandboxSys's).
- **[SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md)**
  - On a RESET: every animal and its ragdoll destroyed and the population drawn again (entities and Jolt bodies created and destroyed).
- **[SphereControl](../systems/SphereControl.md)**
  - Adds a torque to the sphere's Jolt body every tick the held torque is not zero.
  - At a reset teleports the Jolt body and builds the marching cubes colliders around the spawn point synchronously.
  - Logs an error in init when the world does not hold exactly one SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody entity.
- **[SphereObserve](../systems/SphereObserve.md)**
  - Three downward ray casts against the world's static bodies per window.
  - At a trainer RESET, teleports the Jolt body and builds the spawn column's colliders.
- **[SphereTask](../systems/SphereTask.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md)**
  - Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
  - Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.
- **[Torch](../systems/Torch.md)**
  - Creates one entity in init and destroys it in finish.
- **[TreeShade](../systems/service-TreeShade.md)**
  - Signals: connects on_construct<Plant> and on_destroy<Plant> (disconnected in the destructor).
  - GPU: uploads a new 2048x2048 R8 image through Transfer whenever a plant came or went or the light moved (1 degree, 10 with ray tracing); old ones kept for the frames in flight; sets Context::tree_shade_view and tree_shade_sampler.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
- **[VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md)**
  - Hands are only made when VRInput is enabled and box.gltf loads; the RigidBody system gives them kinematic Jolt bodies that push dynamic bodies around.
  - Each press of the right trigger spawns a box 20 cm ahead of the controller with 1.5x the hand's velocity (a new entity and Jolt body per press, never destroyed).
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
- **[VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[VegetationLineup](../systems/VegetationLineup.md)**
  - Creates the lineup's entities once in init (never destroyed by the system).
  - Logs one info line per plant (species, level, position, height).
- **[VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkPlants> in preinit, disconnects in finish.
  - Reads resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs the selected species (info) and a warning per unknown id.
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
- **[animals](../systems/pass-animals.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
  - Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
  - With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.
- **[model](../systems/pass-model.md)**
  - Allocates a descriptor set per material and an image view per texture.
  - Records the indexed draws of every model part into both targets.
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
